implementation_contract.linked_rows: Render only readings, elements, contributions, and related words supplied by app-owned Language Reference Data. Every rendered link opens its corresponding Kanji Detail, Kanji Element Detail, or Word Detail destination, and Back restores the originating position.
implementation_contract.missing_data: Omit a field or section when the selected pinned source has no supported value; do not synthesize a Nihongo-specific placeholder or claim its private missing-data denominator.
implementation_contract.stroke_animation: Use a Zenbu-owned renderer over pinned KanjiVG ordered paths. Preserve initial, step forward/back, play, pause, resume, completion, close, interruption, and cold-relaunch behavior for deterministic one-, eight-, and 29-stroke fixtures; exact Nihongo paths, pixels, and timing are not parity requirements.
implementation_contract.back_gesture: Use standard iOS interactive edge-swipe and Back behavior. Completing the gesture returns to the prior screen; canceling it preserves the current screen and state.
implementation_contract.long_press: Long press is a no-op unless Zenbu intentionally provides a documented context menu for that control.
implementation_contract.gesture_reference_limit: Exact Nihongo edge-swipe, cancellation, long-press menus, no-op behavior, animation, and timing were not observed and are not parity requirements.
